links.explanation: Both reports highlight a lack of effective communication and information sharing between prison healthcare staff and other prison personnel. The earlier report cites broader inter‑agency communication failures, while the later report focuses specifically on the gap between Prison Healthcare and Operational Prison Staff.
links.earlier_quote: There appeared to be not only serious failures of communication, but failures from inadequate processes of communication between custodial and health professionals, between police, court, health care and prison services
links.later_quote: I am concerned that the lack of formal information sharing between the two departments gives rise to a risk of future death. Information sharing between Prison Healthcare and Operational Prison Staff.
